tensions: The live tension is sentiment versus price. F&G fell from 69 to 56 and total cap is off 2.4%, yet ZEC ran 5.5% and SOL 2.8% today — high-beta alts leading while the aggregate weakens is either early rotation or a distribution head-fake, and 24 hours of data cannot tell which. Second tension: full investment at $7.14 buying power means the portfolio has no optionality. If the F&G slide continues into a real flush, there is no dry powder to buy it, and the only source of capital would be selling something — which the no-trim mandate forbids absent a broken thesis. That is a deliberate trade-off, not an oversight, but it should be named: this book is committed to riding the wave without the ability to add on weakness.
